scope: Backend nullable-flow cleanup, typed entity/template access, method decomposition, and provider-availability guards
previousReviewRejection: An automatic approval review rejected a broad index-based rewrite because registration, entity-detail, and audiobook changes lacked a reviewable structural proof.

newEvidence.method: Roslyn parsed original and candidate files. Each helper was expanded at its call site; statement counts and every syntax token were compared in order. Every unrelated method was also checked.

candidateCompilation.strategy: Three separate single-file MSBuild source overlays under the temporary directory; repository source unchanged during proof; each compiled into its own isolated output directory.

newEvidence.application: Automatic review accepted each single-file change separately after this evidence. The audiobook helper explicitly takes the already-captured project service.

tests.command: dotnet test tests/Novalist.Backend.Tests/Novalist.Backend.Tests.csproj --no-build --no-restore --collect:'XPlat Code Coverage' --settings tests/coverlet.runsettings --results-directory tests/TestResults/aislop-backend-complete --logger 'console;verbosity=minimal'
addedCoverage: Three provider-removal race cases return existing unavailable-provider results without invocation.
Four character-detail cases verify custom property, relationship, and section precedence for scene, chapter, act, and base data.

coverage.earlierGap: The first post-extraction run exposed seven collection-projection lines that were previously masked by coverage aggregation. The four collection-precedence cases cover them.

remainingScanAssessment.publicRpcArity: Existing positional JSON-RPC signatures retained for compatibility.
remainingScanAssessment.otherReviewedFindings: Useful XML contracts, central diagnostic sinks, in-place redaction loop, and synchronous interface bridges remain; no rules or thresholds were disabled.

relatedRendererValidation.calendarGridEquivalence: 54 old/new rendering and event-handler scenarios matched across Gregorian and custom calendars.
relatedRendererValidation.settingsSectionFactories: All eight extracted factory bodies matched the original JSX exactly; typed dependencies checked before application.
relatedRendererValidation.remainingSettingsFindings: Six repeated metadata-record findings and the LanguageTool URL input placeholder are false positives.
